meta.name: golden-chat
meta.description: Use when testing the golden_chat golden build

copy.tagline: 测试聊天功能是否正常
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速验证聊天模块是否可用
copy.tagline_en: Test if the chat function works
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly verify the chat module is working

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查询 golden_chat 的 Slack 聊天记录，包括工程和随机频道的讨论、代码片段、共享链接等。
howto.when: 当你需要查找 golden_chat 团队在 Slack 中讨论过的解决方案、代码片段、决策或共享资源时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一下 golden_chat 聊天中分享的 Python 代码片段。
say.note: Claude 会列出聊天中的代码片段。

say.text: golden_chat 团队在 Slack 里分享了哪些链接？
say.note: Claude 会返回共享链接列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query golden_chat Slack chat history, including discussions, code snippets, and shared links from #engineering and #random channels.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to find solutions, code snippets, decisions, or shared resources from golden_chat team's Slack conversations.

say_en.text: What troubleshooting discussions are in golden_chat's #engineering channel?
say_en.note: Claude will search engineering channel chat history.

say_en.text: Find Python code snippets shared in golden_chat chat.
say_en.note: Claude will list code snippets from the chat.

say_en.text: What links did the golden_chat team share on Slack?
say_en.note: Claude will return the list of shared links.
